app_command.description: The command to run the target application that will be monitored by MangoHud via mangoapp.

width.description: Target internal resolution width for gamescope.

height.description: Target internal resolution height for gamescope.

refresh_rate.description: Target refresh rate in Hz for gamescope.

env_vars.description:
List of environment variables to set for the MangoHud overlay and application. Format: [ {name: string, value: string}, ... ]
Note: This is a flat list of objects. Each object must have 'name' and 'value' fields.
Common MangoHud env vars: MANGOHUD=1, MANGOHUD_CONFIG=/path/to/config.conf, etc.
Items schema:
- name: string - Environment variable name
- value: string - Environment variable value
      default: []
